programme.title: Football: Elite Champions League of Asia: Round 1: Al Sharja - Al Garafa / Футбол: Елитна Шампионска лига на Азия: 1 кръг: Ал Шарджа - Ал Гарафа
programme.desc: The Elite Champions League of Asia is a football club competition, featuring the best clubs from Asian football leagues, organized under the auspices of AFC. This is the most important club football competition on the continent and is the equivalent of the European Champions League. By the fall of 2024, the tournament was taken as the AFC Champions League of Asia, but from that moment the race was renamed to the elite Champions League of Asia / Елитната Шампионска лига на Азия е футболно клубно състезание, в което участват най-добрите клубове от азиатските футболни лиги, организирано под егидата на АФК . Това е най-важното клубно футболно състезание на континента и е еквивалент на Европейската шампионска лига. До есента на 2024 г. турнирът е извстен като АФК Шампионска лига на Азия, но от този момент надпреварата е преименувана на Елитна Шампионска лига на Азия

programme.title: Tennis: Davis Cup: Match 4: Australia - Belgium / Тенис: Купа Дейвис: Мач 4: Австралия - Белгия
programme.desc: The tournament was established in 1900 at the initiative of American tennis player Dwight Davis, with the first edition being a meeting between the US and the UK. Gradually, the race is growing and today is among the largest sporting events with the participation of many countries around the world. Each clash is held in format up to three wins from five matches - on the first day two singles are played, and in the second one follows a match in pairs and two reverse singles. Since 2019, the structure of the tournament has been upgraded and already includes qualification stages, group phase and final eight, in which the top eight teams argue for the award. / Турнирът е създаден през 1900 г. по инициатива на американския тенисист Дуайт Дейвис, като първото издание е било среща между САЩ и Великобритания. Постепенно надпреварата се разраства и днес е сред най-мащабните спортни събития с участие на множество държави от целия свят. Всеки сблъсък се провежда във формат до три победи от пет срещи – в първия ден се изиграват два сингъла, а във втория следват мач по двойки и два обратни сингъла. От 2019 г. структурата на турнира е модернизирана, като вече включва квалификационни етапи, групова фаза и финална осмица, в която най-добрите осем отбора спорят за отличието.

programme.title: Asia Champions League 2: Obzor / Шампионска лига на Азия 2: Обзор
programme.desc: The show offers a detailed review of the main events and results of the second edition of the tournament. Each episode focuses on decisive matches, big victories and unexpected twists. Experts and analysts reveal the tactical approaches of the teams, note the most remarkable individual achievements and explore moments that change the course of the competitions. The show is perfect for anyone who follows Asian club football and want to get acquainted with the most exciting events in the tournament. / Предаването предлага детайлен преглед на основните събития и резултати от второто издание на турнира. Във всеки епизод се акцентира на решаващите мачове, големите победи и неочакваните обрати. Експерти и анализатори разкриват тактическите подходи на отборите, отбелязват най-забележителните индивидуални постижения и изследват моменти, които променят хода на състезанията. Предаването е перфектно за всички, които следят азиатския клубен футбол и искат да се запознаят с най-вълнуващите събития в турнира.

programme.title: Horse Sport: Cup of Bulgaria, Yambol: Day 1 / Конен спорт: Купа на България, Ямбол: Ден 1
programme.desc: "Cup of Bulgaria" in Yambol is a circle of the national obstacle skipping tournament held at the horse base near the village of Kabile. The event brings together riders from all over the country and is part of an initiative to promote horse sport and the Bulgarian regions. / "Купа на България" в Ямбол е кръг от националния турнир по прескачане на препятствия, провеждан в конната база край село Кабиле. Събитието събира ездачи от цялата страна и е част от инициатива за популяризиране на конния спорт и българските региони.

programme.desc: League 1 consists of 20 teams that compete against each other in 38 rounds, changed. The French Championship dates from 1892, the so -called Amateur League until 1929. In 1932, the foundations of professionally organized football in France were laid. The French Division 1 includes in its first season 1932-33 the following teams, divided into two groups: Club France, Excelsior, Ier, Lille, Marseille, Muluz, Nice, Nim, Racing Paris, Ale, Antib, Khan, are Paris, Fiv, Montz, Red Star, Ren and Sosho. Френският шампионат датира от 1892, така нареченета Аматьорска лига до 1929. През 1932 се полагат основите на професионално организраният футбол във Франция. Френската Дивизия 1 включва в своя първи сезон 1932-33 следните отбори, разделени в две групи: Клуб Франсе, Екселсиор, Иер, Лил, Марсилия, Мюлуз, Ница, Ним, Расинг Париж, Сет, Але, Антиб, Кан, СА Париж, Фив, Метц, Монпелие, Ред Стар, Рен и Сошо. През последните години доста по-късно сформирания клуб Пари Сен Жермен е абсолютен доминатор на домашната сцена, но преди това много успехи са имали също Лион, Марсилия, Бордо, Монако, Нан, Сен Етиен, Рейм, Ница, Ланс и др.

programme.title: Tennis: Davis Cup: Match 5: Croatia - France / Тенис: Купа Дейвис: Мач 5: Хърватия - Франция
programme.desc: The tournament was established in 1900 at the initiative of American tennis player Dwight Davis, with the first edition being a meeting between the US and the UK. Gradually, the race is growing and today is among the largest sporting events with the participation of many countries around the world. Each clash is held in format up to three wins from five matches - on the first day two singles are played, and in the second one follows a match in pairs and two reverse singles. Since 2019, the structure of the tournament has been upgraded and already includes qualification stages, group phase and final eight, in which the top eight teams argue for the award. / Турнирът е създаден през 1900 г. по инициатива на американския тенисист Дуайт Дейвис, като първото издание е било среща между САЩ и Великобритания. Постепенно надпреварата се разраства и днес е сред най-мащабните спортни събития с участие на множество държави от целия свят. Всеки сблъсък се провежда във формат до три победи от пет срещи – в първия ден се изиграват два сингъла, а във втория следват мач по двойки и два обратни сингъла. От 2019 г. структурата на турнира е модернизирана, като вече включва квалификационни етапи, групова фаза и финална осмица, в която най-добрите осем отбора спорят за отличието.

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E28, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E28, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.desc: Earth - (E01, Educational Program, England, 2023) Discover the unimaginable four billion years old story about our native planet, told in five dramatic episodes. We follow what was happening in our world before we cracked from the mud - and this includes bombing from space, extreme changes in climate and collision of entire continents. ---------- Chris Packham explores one of the darkest periods in the history of the country: the largest mass extinction that the planet experienced, when as many as 90% of all kinds were extinct 252 million years ago. Ali ljudi su u drugom planu ove pripovijesti. Središnji položaj zauzima Zemlja. Pratimo što se događalo na našem svijetu prije nego smo ispuzali iz blata - a to uključuje bombardiranja iz svemira, ekstremne promjene klime i sudare cijelih kontinenata. -------- Chris Packham istražuje jedno od najmračnijih razdoblja u povijesti Zemlje: najveće masovno izumiranje koje je planet doživio, kada je prije 252 milijuna godina izumrlo čak 90% svih vrsta. Taj izvanredan trenutak u povijesti Zemlje doveo je život do ruba, izazvavši pustoš i razaranje neviđenih razmjera. No život se nekako uspio oporaviti, a nova geološka era najavila je doba dinosaura. programme.title: 60. Vinkovci Autumn / 60. Vinkovačke jeseni
programme.desc: 60. Vinkovci Autumn - (entertainment program, Croatia, 2025) Apple is a symbol and characteristic of the beginnings of maintaining the Vinkovci Autumn, in the 1960s, at the Borinci plantation, located in the vicinity of Vinkovci, which is why she was also woven into the coat of arms of this event, author of Jose Matakovic. The first years of maintaining the Vinkovci Autumn are, therefore, just for an apple, which would include the most beautiful girl, beauty, the winner of the folk costume, the Mladost event and the beauty of Slavonia in Stari Mikanovci. Therefore, the dramatic text of this year's solemn opening of the Jubilee, 60th Vinkovci Autumn, author of Marko Sabljakovic, under the title Autumn Bishop's apple - will be a stage to evoke a story in whose center the character of a young girl, Shoki -Slavonka, whose apple will symbolically bring a handful of joy into life. But the story will be enriched with interesting events related to the establishment of the event, as well as important persons who contributed to it. All of this, in the author's opinion, deserves the memory of the beginnings of the event, which over time included Vinkovci among the most significant places of events related to nurturing and presenting traditional culture in Croatia and beyond its borders. Transmission Director: Mirena Stijačić Producer of Transmission: Mate Letica Editor of the Transmission: Alexei Pavlovsky ... / 60. Vinkovačke jeseni - (zabavni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Jabuka je simbol i obilježje početaka održavanja Vinkovačkih jeseni, davnih šezdesetih godina prošlog stoljeća, na plantaži Borinci, smještenoj u okolici Vinkovaca, zbog čega je i izgledom utkana u grb ove priredbe, autora Joze Matakovića, vinkovačkog akademskog slikara i scenografa. Prve godine održavanja Vinkovačkih jeseni vezane su, dakle, baš za jabuku koju bi na Borincima ubrala najljepša djevojka, ljepotica, pobjednica revije narodnih nošnji, priredbe Mladost i ljepota Slavonije u Starim Mikanovcima. Stoga će i dramski tekst ovogodišnjeg svečanog otvorenja jubilarnih, 60. Vinkovačkih jeseni, autora Marka Sabljakovića, pod naslovom Jesen rumeni jabuka - scenski dočarati priču u čijem je središtu lik mlade djevojke, Šokice-Slavonke, kojoj će jabuka simbolično u život unijeti pregršt radosti. No, priča će biti obogaćena i zanimljivim događajima vezanima uz osnivanje manifestacije, kao i važnim osobama koje su tome dale svoj doprinos. Sve to, prema mišljenju autora, zaslužuje sjećanje o počecima priredbe koja je tijekom vremena uvrstila Vinkovce među najznačajnija mjesta zbivanja vezanih uz njegovanje i predstavljanje tradicijske kulture u Hrvatskoj i izvan njezinih granica. programme.title: Sean Connery against James Bond / Sean Connery protiv Jamesa Bonda
programme.desc: Sean Connery Vs James Bond - (Doc. Film, France, 2022) In 1963, a young acting hope appeared on stage in James Bond - Dr. But the first sequel from the movie series that will become legendary. His name? Connery. Sean Connery. The role of James Bond brought Sean Connery fame and wealth, but it became a burden to him. The actor has long been trying to separate himself from his character of the agent 007 and play more demanding characters. At the end of his mission filled with struggle, misses and disappointments, the masculine hero managed to transform himself into a wise old man with a gray beard - but he was still equally sexy! He was a mentor of the new generation of actors in cult films such as untouchable and Indiana Jones and the last crusade, and became one of the most respected actors of contemporary cinema. With the help of rare and exclusive archival recordings and the actors and directors he recorded with, including Andy Garcia, John Boorman, Rob Brown, his biographer Michael Feeney Callan, Christopher Bray and Lise Funnell, who analyzed his role as James Bond through the prism of his native friends Murray Grigor, this movie reveals to us more about one of the most respected Hollywood actors. The director is Gregory Monro, winner of Emmy for the movie Kubrick by Kubrick. R.: Gregory Monro Ul.: Sean Connery (Self), John Boorman (Self - film Director), Andy Garcia (Self), Rob Brown (Self), Murray Grigor (Self - Biographor) ... / Sean Connery vs James Bond - (dok. film, Francuska, 2022) Godine 1963. mlada se glumačka nada pojavila na sceni u filmu James Bond - Dr. No, prvom nastavku iz serijala filmova koji će postati legendarnima. Njegovo ime? Connery. Sean Connery. Uloga Jamesa Bonda donijela je Seanu Conneryu slavu i bogatstvo, ali postala mu je i svojevrstan teret. Glumac se dugo pokušavao odijeliti od svog lika agenta 007 te glumiti zahtjevnije likove. Na kraju svoje misije ispunjene borbom, promašajima i razočaranjima, muževni se junak uspio preobraziti u mudrog starca sijede brade - no i dalje je bio jednako seksi! Bio je mentor novom naraštaju glumaca u kultnim filmovima kao što su Nedodirljivi i Indiana Jones i posljednji križarski pohod, te je postao jedan od najcjenjenijih glumaca suvremene kinematografije. Uz pomoć rijetkih i ekskluzivnih arhivskih snimki te glumaca i redatelja s kojima je snimao, a među kojima su Andy Garcia, John Boorman, Rob Brown, njegovih biografa Michaela Feeneyja Callana, Christophera Braya i Lise Funnell koja je analizirala njegovu ulogu Jamesa Bonda kroz prizmu rodnih uloga, te jednoga od njegovih najbliskijih prijatelja Murrayja Grigora, ovaj nam film otkriva više o jednom od najcjenjenijih holivudskih glumaca. Redatelj je Gregory Monro, dobitnik Emmyja za film Kubrick by Kubrick. R.: Gregory Monro Ul.: Sean Connery (Self), John Boorman (Self - Film Director), Andy Garcia (Self), Rob Brown (Self), Murray Grigor (Self - Biographer)...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E28, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E28, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Momo / Momo
programme.desc: Momo - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2022), although she was seemingly told all the generations that the war broke off, the Momi story for thirty years waited to be told. Because Momo was different. He was not restrained by the boundaries of nationality, his homeland was Europe without borders, and great love literature and writing. On the eve of the war, he was part of a peculiar and gifted generation of the Bjelovar cultural scene. The unemployed writer, as he liked to call himself, published stories in Fanzina "leaning butterfly". Bjelovarčanin Momčilo Vukašinović, Croatian Volunteer, a member of the A company, the 105th Brigade of the Croatian Army, died on December 4, 1991 in the defense of Komletinac with five other fellow soldiers. Mom's letter to my friend Drazen Buhin is a kind of will of a man who goes to the battlefield, aware that he may not return. How much he meant to the whole generation of Bjelovarci is testified by the songs that he dedicated to him after the death, just like books with his stories his friends have been actively published by. In addition to them, Momini's fellow soldiers, as well as the veterans of Komletin, speak in the film, a place that was defended on the day of his death ... / Momo - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2022) Iako su je naizgled pričale sve generacije kojima je rat prekinuo snove, priča o Momi trideset je godina čekala da bude ispričana. Jer Momo je bio drukčiji. Njega nisu sputavale granice nacionalnosti, njegova je domovina bila Europa bez granica, a velika ljubav književnost i pisanje. U predvečerje rata bio je dio osebujnog i darovitog naraštaja bjelovarske kulturne scene. Nezaposleni pisac, kako je sam sebe volio nazivati, priče je objavljivao u fanzinu "Naginjući leptiru". Bjelovarčanin Momčilo Vukašinović, hrvatski dragovoljac, pripadnik A satnije, 105. brigade Hrvatske vojske, poginuo je 4. prosinca 1991. u obrani Komletinaca s još petoricom suboraca. Momino pismo prijatelju Draženu Buhinu svojevrsna je oporuka čovjeka koji odlazi na ratište, svjestan da se možda neće vratiti. Koliko je značio cijelom jednom naraštaju Bjelovarčana, svjedoče pjesme koje su mu nakon pogibije posvetili, baš kao i knjige s njegovim pričama koje su njegovi prijatelji postumno objavili. Uz njih u filmu govore i Momini suborci, ali i branitelji Komletinaca, mjesta koje je na dan njegove pogibije obranjeno...

programme.title: Sean Connery against James Bond / Sean Connery protiv Jamesa Bonda
programme.desc: Sean Connery Vs James Bond - (Doc. Film, France, 2022) In 1963, a young acting hope appeared on stage in James Bond - Dr. But the first sequel from the movie series that will become legendary. His name? Connery. Sean Connery. The role of James Bond brought Sean Connery fame and wealth, but it became a burden to him. The actor has long been trying to separate himself from his character of the agent 007 and play more demanding characters. At the end of his mission filled with struggle, misses and disappointments, the masculine hero managed to transform himself into a wise old man with a gray beard - but he was still equally sexy! He was a mentor of the new generation of actors in cult films such as untouchable and Indiana Jones and the last crusade, and became one of the most respected actors of contemporary cinema. With the help of rare and exclusive archival recordings and the actors and directors he recorded with, including Andy Garcia, John Boorman, Rob Brown, his biographer Michael Feeney Callan, Christopher Bray and Lise Funnell, who analyzed his role as James Bond through the prism of his native friends Murray Grigor, this movie reveals to us more about one of the most respected Hollywood actors. R.: Gregory Monro Ul.: Sean Connery (Self), John Boorman (Self - film Director), Andy Garcia (Self), Rob Brown (Self), Murray Grigor (Self - Biographor) ... / Sean Connery vs James Bond - (dok. film, Francuska, 2022) Godine 1963. mlada se glumačka nada pojavila na sceni u filmu James Bond - Dr. No, prvom nastavku iz serijala filmova koji će postati legendarnima. Njegovo ime? Connery. Sean Connery. Uloga Jamesa Bonda donijela je Seanu Conneryu slavu i bogatstvo, ali postala mu je i svojevrstan teret. Glumac se dugo pokušavao odijeliti od svog lika agenta 007 te glumiti zahtjevnije likove. Na kraju svoje misije ispunjene borbom, promašajima i razočaranjima, muževni se junak uspio preobraziti u mudrog starca sijede brade - no i dalje je bio jednako seksi! Bio je mentor novom naraštaju glumaca u kultnim filmovima kao što su Nedodirljivi i Indiana Jones i posljednji križarski pohod, te je postao jedan od najcjenjenijih glumaca suvremene kinematografije. Uz pomoć rijetkih i ekskluzivnih arhivskih snimki te glumaca i redatelja s kojima je snimao, a među kojima su Andy Garcia, John Boorman, Rob Brown, njegovih biografa Michaela Feeneyja Callana, Christophera Braya i Lise Funnell koja je analizirala njegovu ulogu Jamesa Bonda kroz prizmu rodnih uloga, te jednoga od njegovih najbliskijih prijatelja Murrayja Grigora, ovaj nam film otkriva više o jednom od najcjenjenijih holivudskih glumaca. R.: Gregory Monro Ul.: Sean Connery (Self), John Boorman (Self - Film Director), Andy Garcia (Self), Rob Brown (Self), Murray Grigor (Self - Biographer)...

programme.title: Drank intrade and are thirsty again / Popili intrade i opet su žedni
programme.desc: They drank intrade and are thirsty again - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2023) when they started 38 years ago, they didn't even suspect their path, where they would take them, where to bring everything to the Klapa song, the name of their Zadar and their Croatian, how many beautiful songs will sing, how many people will love them and their songs ... This documentary is about them. The loyal audience follows them wherever they appear, perform from Europe to America and New Zealand, the songs have millions of millions on YouTube ... The only klapa with two appearances at the Zagreb Arena, Spaladium Arena and Arena Stožice and Klapa with the published exclusive monograph whose author is journalist Davorka Mezic. Through conversation with Tomislav Bralić and the members of the Klapa, the authors who wrote the Klapa most important songs, friends and people from public life that speak of the importance of the Klapa for Croatia, we will immerse yourself in their world and reveal unknown stories from their exceptional career. The movie reveals that it happened that a klapa that was created in an environment without a strong klapa scene succeeds at the Olympus Klapa, in Omiš. R .: Igor Goic ... / Popili intrade i opet su žedni - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Kad su prije 38 godina krenuli, nisu ni slutili na kakav put kreću, kamo će ih odvesti, kuda će sve pronositi klapsku pjesmu, ime svojega Zadra i svoje Hrvatske, koliko će prelijepih pjesama otpjevati, koliko će ljudi voljeti njih i njihove pjesme... Ovaj dokumentarni film priča je o njima - o Tomislavu Braliću i klape Intrade. Vjerna ih publika prati gdje god se pojave, nastupaju od Europe do Amerike i Novog Zelanda, pjesme im broje milijunske preglede na YouTubeu... Jedina su klapa s dva nastupa u Areni Zagreb, Spaladium Areni i Areni Stožice i klapa s objavljenom ekskluzivnom monografijom čija je autorica novinarka Davorka Mezić. Kroz razgovor s Tomislavom Bralićem i članovima klape, autorima koji su napisali klapi najvažnije pjesme, prijateljima i osobama iz javnog života koji govore o važnosti klape za Hrvatsku, uronit ćemo u njihov svijet i otkriti nepoznate priče iz njihove iznimne karijere. Film otkriva kako se dogodilo da klapa koja je nastala u okruženju bez jake klapske scene uspije na klapskom Olimpu, u Omišu. R.: Igor Goić...

programme.title: A deadly fire / Smrtonosni požar
programme.desc: He Fire - (movie, USA, 2023) thriller/drama about a poignant journey of a family trying to save himself and escape from a forest fire that rushes at their home in the wooded hills of California at high speed. Forest fires take almost 4000 lives in the US every year. This movie brings a convincing story of what the escape from this unpredictable horrors looks like. The film follows a regular American family with the usual life problems that suddenly are forced to fight for life when a devastating fire in the Californian town of Colberg in which they live suddenly erupts. A series of tragic losses and danger awaits them on that unexpected path that draws viewers in a tense story full of action. By the way, they find the tools they need: a little faith, strength and mutual love, and support and assistance of members of the emergency service, which gives them the odds of them to draw a living head. R .: Peter Facinelli Ul.: Peter Facinelli (Dave Laughlin), Fiona Dourif (Sarah Laughlin), Asher Angel (Clay Laughlin), Lance Henriksen (George Laughlin), Ashlei Foushee (Kayla the Operator) ... / On Fire - (film, SAD, 2023) Triler/drama o potresnom putovanju jedne obitelji koja se pokušava spasiti i pobjeći od šumskog požara koji velikom brzinom juri prema njihovu domu u šumovitim brdima Kalifornije. Šumski požari svake godine odnose gotovo 4000 života u SAD-u. Ovaj film donosi uvjerljivu priču o tome kako izgleda bijeg od ove nepredvidive strahote. Film prati običnu američku obitelj s uobičajenim životnim problemima koja je odjedanput prisiljena boriti se za život kad iznenada izbije razorni požar u kalifornijskom gradiću Colbergu u kojem žive. Niz tragičnih gubitaka i opasnosti čeka ih na tom neočekivanom putu koji gledatelje uvlači u napetu priču punu akcije. Usput pronalaze alate koji su im potrebni: malo vjere, snagu i međusobnu ljubav, i potporu i pomoć pripadnika hitnih službi, što im sve daje izglede da izvuku živu glavu. programme.title: We discover Croatia / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku
programme.desc: We discover Croatia - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2025) there used to be a lot of salt in Croatia in Croatia. Especially in the Middle Ages, Solane in Pag, Nin, Ston, Trogir, Rab, Krk and Cres were known. These cities were enriched thanks to the salt pans. Because of the salt, it fought. In the Roman Empire, the soldiers were paid with salt, in Latin it was called Salarium. And from there the English word for salary salary. Salt was so valuable that they called her white gold. Today, there are three salt socks in Croatia - Pag, Nin and Ston. R.: Zrinka Krešo ... / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) U Hrvatskoj je nekada na Jadranu postojalo dosta solana. Posebice u srednjem vijeku poznate su bile solane u Pagu, Ninu, Stonu, Trogiru, Rabu, Krku i Cresu. Ovi su se gradovi i obogatili zahvaljujući solanama. Zbog soli se ratovalo. U Rimskom Carstvu vojnici su bili plaćeni solju, na latinskom to se zvalo salarium. I od tuda engleska riječ za plaću salary. Sol je bila toliko vrijedna da su je zvali bijelo zlato. Danas u Hrvatskoj još postoje tri solane - Pag, Nin i Ston. R.: Zrinka Krešo...

programme.title: South America Simon Reeve / Južna Amerika sa Simonom Reeveom
programme.desc: Simon Reeves South America - (E05, Nature. Film, England, 2022) The last stage of Simon's trip to South America leads us from the Atacame Chilean desert to the Fire Land, the southernmost area in the world where people live. Atacama is one of the smallest places on Earth. About 1 mm of precipitation drops there during the year. However, Simon reveals shocking traces of pollution here. Next to the isolated port city of Iquique is a huge landfill where there are huge hills of old clothes. This is a consequence of the so -called. Fast fashion because people from rich countries throw millions of garments every day. Simon will also meet some of the millions of Venezuelan refugees here who have escaped their country and have moved to a better life throughout the world. In Buenos Aires, Argentina Simon reveals that it is to live with an inflation rate that is so high that all our problems seem negligible compared to it. They will continue their journey to Patagonia and get to know the people of Mapuche, whose rebellion in Chile has caused a great crisis. During the mess, they burned farms and trucks transporting trees of trees, and many people were killed. This is the last chapter of a long struggle for land and rights. Simon will conclude his trap in South America in a distant fiery country. There, he learns that the local population has resisted the opening of huge salmon farms that have caused great damage to the environment in the north. This is also the optimistic end of Simon's epic journey to South America and the US continent. R .: Freddie Martin ... / Simon Reeves South America - (E05, prirod. film, Engleska, 2022) Posljednja etapa Simonova putovanja Južnom Amerikom vodi nas od čileanske pustinje Atacame pa sve do Ognjene zemlje, najjužnijeg područja na svijetu na kojemu žive ljudi. Atacama je jedno od najsuših mjesta na Zemlji. Tijekom godine ondje padne oko 1 mm oborina. Međutim, Simon ovdje otkriva šokantne tragove onečišćenja. Pokraj izoliranog lučkog grada Iquiquea nalazi se golemo odlagalište otpada na kojemu su golema brda stare odjeće. To je posljedica tzv. brze mode jer ljudi iz bogatih zemalja svakodnevno bacaju milijune odjevnih predmeta. Simon će i ovdje susresti neke od milijuna venezuelanskih izbjeglica koji su pobjegli iz svoje zemlje te su se u potrazi za boljim životom raselili diljem cijeloga svijeta. U Buenos Airesu u Argentini Simon otkriva kako je živjeti s inflacijskom stopom koja je toliko visoka da u usporedbi s njom svi naši problemi čine se zanemarivima. Svoje će putovanje nastaviti Patagonijom i upoznati narod Mapuche čija je pobuna u Čileu uzrokovala veliku krizu. Tijekom nereda spalili su farme i kamione koji prevoze trupce stabala, a poginulo je i mnogo ljudi. Zadnje je to poglavlje duge borbe za zemlju i prava. Svoje proputovanje Južnom Amerikom Simon će zaključiti u dalekoj Ognjenoj zemlji. Ondje saznaje kako se mjesno stanovništvo oduprlo otvaranju golemih uzgajališta lososa koje su na sjeveru nanijela veliku štetu okolišu. Prikladan je to i optimistični kraj Simonova epskog putovanja Južnom Amerikom i američkim kontinentom. R.: Freddie Martin...

programme.title: Clarkson's pharmacy / Clarksonova farma
programme.desc: Clarksons Farm - (S02, E03, Nature. Film, England, 2023) Jeremy presents West Oxfordshire councilors his idea of ​​conversion of lamb space - which he now gaps empty because he left his sheep to care for a local farmer - to a restaurant. But besides being awaiting bureaucracy, and it seems that the paperwork will be overwhelmed here, Jeremy must also get the locals of Chadlington. programme.desc: National Parks - (E06, Educational Program, Croatia, 2010) On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of the founding of the Mljet National Park "Mljet" Croatian Television in 2010, it recorded a show showing a state of protected area of ​​nature and promotes the protection of the natural and cultural heritage of the island of Mljet and Croatia. It has been 50 years since the Croatian Parliament on November 11, 1960, passed a special law, on the basis of which the Mljet Municipality of Mljet Park set the administration of the Mljet National Park on May 30, 1960. The protection of the island of Mljet was preceded by the protection of marine lakes, which was protected by Emperor Austria in 1910 as a "Naturschutz Park" and the first colony of Mungos was disembarked on the island of Mongos in August of the same year, which saved the population from poisonous snakes. In 1929, academician Branimir Gusic holds a PhD in the topic of anthropogeographic characteristics of Mljet, which will prove to be the basis of future protection of natural and cultural values. On February 27, 1948, the People's Republic of Croatia protected the area of ​​the Northwest of the Northwestern Northwestern part of the island as a "protected natural rarity of the lake with the surrounding area on the island of Mljet". programme.title: National Parks / Nacionalni parkovi
programme.desc: National Parks - (E06, Educational Program, Croatia, 2010) On the occasion of the 50th anniversary of the founding of the Mljet National Park "Mljet" Croatian Television in 2010, it recorded a show showing a state of protected area of ​​nature and promotes the protection of the natural and cultural heritage of the island of Mljet and Croatia. It has been 50 years since the Croatian Parliament on November 11, 1960, passed a special law, on the basis of which the Mljet Municipality of Mljet Park set the administration of the Mljet National Park on May 30, 1960. The protection of the island of Mljet was preceded by the protection of marine lakes, which was protected by Emperor Austria in 1910 as a "Naturschutz Park" and the first colony of Mungos was disembarked on the island of Mongos in August of the same year, which saved the population from poisonous snakes. In 1929, academician Branimir Gusic holds a PhD in the topic of anthropogeographic characteristics of Mljet, which will prove to be the basis of future protection of natural and cultural values. On February 27, 1948, the People's Republic of Croatia protected the area of ​​the Northwest of the Northwestern Northwestern part of the island as a "protected natural rarity of the lake with the surrounding area on the island of Mljet". R .: Dominik Zen ... / Nacionalni parkovi - (E06, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2010) U povodu 50. godišnjice osnutka Nacionalnog parka "Mljet" Hrvatska televizija 2010. godine snimila je emisiju u kojoj se prikazuje stanje zaštićenog područja prirode i promovira zaštita prirodne i kulturne baštine otoka Mljeta i Hrvatske. Prošlo je 50 godina od kada je Hrvatski sabor 11. studenog 1960. donio poseban zakon na temelju kojeg je 30. svibnja 1960. godine Općina Mljet osnovala Upravu Nacionalnog parka "Mljet". Zaštiti prirode otoka Mljeta prethodila je zaštita morskih jezera koje je kao "Naturschutz Park" zaštitila Carevina Austrija 1910. te je u kolovozu iste godine na otok iskrcana prva kolonija mungosa koja je spasila stanovništvo od zmija otrovnica. Akademik Branimir Gušić 1929. godine doktorira na temu antropogeografskih karakteristika Mljeta što će se pokazati kao osnova buduće zaštite prirodnih i kulturnih vrijednosti. Narodna Republika Hrvatska je 27. veljače 1948. Odlukom Zemaljskog zavoda za zaštitu prirodnih rijetkosti zaštitila područje sjeverozapadnog dijela otoka kao "zaštićenu prirodnu rijetkost jezera s okolicom na otoku Mljetu". R.: Dominik Zen...

But huge popularity has reached caricatures that she posts on social networks. Two minimalistly drawn characters in completely daily situations: these are them. And finally, in our section we knock on the door of forgotten aces - critic Dario Grgic talks about the unusual book by Czesława Miłosz. I za kraj, u našoj rubrici kucamo na vrata zaboravljenih asova - kritičar Dario Grgić govori o neobičnoj knjizi Czesława Miłosza. programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) We follow the premiere performance of comic opera "Sold Bride" Bedřich Smetana, which was held in mid -June 2024 at the HNK Osijek. The topic is a romantic burlesque on folk topics and customs that reflects many kinships with the Slavic and Slavonian national being. This is felt by director Petra B. Blašković, who is the actress of the Drama Ensemble of the same theater, who, from a young age, wants the opportunity to direct one opera and now has given her an intendant Vladimir Ham a chance. With her harmonious solutions in the style of a fairytale picture book, through which she creates a departure from the harsh motif of the "bride for sale" and opera soloists, all members of the permanent composition of the Osijek opera: Katarina Toplek Horvat (Marica), Matic Lawyk (Ward), Igor Krišto (Janko), Berislav Pushkaric (Kecal). What he writes in the score and how to direct an opera, he reveals to us the conductor of Osijek with Zagreb address, the conductor of the Comedy City Theater in Zagreb, Kresimir Batinic, to whom this is the first meeting with the opera, because so far he has exclusively made concerts, operas and musicals. But we were also on the reconstruction of the play this fall and November 21, what they were performing, and what the views on this production, the director of Osijek Opera, Ladislav Vrgoč, and two soprano in the "second" division - Tena Lončarević (Marica) and Ilijana Koć Teklić (Esmeralda) ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Pratimo premijernu izvedbu komične opere "Prodana nevjesta" Bedřicha Smetane, koja je sredinom lipnja 2024. uprizorena u osječkome HNK-u. Tema je romantična burleska na folklorne teme i običaje koja odražava mnoge srodnosti sa slavenskim i slavonskim nacionalnim bićem. To osjeća redateljica Petra B. Blašković, inače glumica Dramskog ansambla istoga kazališta koja od mladosti priželjkuje prigodu da režira jednu operu i sada joj je intendant Vladimir Ham dao šansu. S njezinim su skladnim rješenjima u stilu bajkovite slikovnice kroz koju stvara odmak od surovog motiva "nevjeste na prodaju" slažu i operni solisti, sve redom članovi stalnog sastava Osječke opere: Katarina Toplek Horvat (Marica), Matic Zakonjšek (Vašek), Igor Krišto (Janko), Berislav Puškarić (Kecal) i Iva Herman (Esmeralda). Što sve piše u partituri i kako mu je režirati operu, otkriva nam osječki dirigent sa zagrebačkom adresom, dirigent Gradskog kazališta Komedija u Zagrebu, Krešimir Batinić, kojemu je ovo prvi susret s operom, jer je dosad isključivo radio koncerte, operete i mjuzikle. Ali bili smo i na obnovi predstave ove jeseni i 21. studenoga zabilježili, što nastupe, a što stajališta o ovoj produkciji, ravnatelja Osječke opere, Ladislava Vrgoča, te dviju sopranistica u "drugoj" podjeli - Tene Lončarević (Marica) i Ilijane Korać Teklić (Esmeralda)...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2025) The name of Miljenko Prohaska is one of those who, from the earliest encounters with our music, is in memory. There are few people who have marked modern popular but also serious music in this area to this extent. It could even be said that her history and the prohasque biography in most of the 20th century are practically synonymous. In this overlap that lasted for decades - from the very end of the 30s to his death in 2014 - especially the line that Prohaska shares with the domestic jazz. Not only is he a pioneer of the Croatian and Yugoslav jazz, it is also one of his most important institutional drivers. He is one of the founders of the Radio Zagreb Dance Orchestra, today's jazz orchestra of HRT, whose chief Dirigent has been more than three decades. He was a member of the Zagreb Jazz Quartet and Quintet, and in addition to domestic musicians, he made a number of collaborations with the world's jazz greats, such as John Lewis and Art Farmer. Prohaska, along with Bosko Petrovic, is certainly our internationally known Jazist, first and foremost as a conductor and composer. For example, in 1967, at the famed Monterey festival, Don Ellisa's orchestra was performed by his own compositions, while the famed Downbeat included him among the most important jazz conductor. His "intimacy", created in 1962, was considered an internationally most performed Croatian jazz composition. It is best to pay tribute to music, and this is exactly what made the founded Proha Big Band at the end of March at the Vatroslav Lisinski Concert Hall, playing the author's concert under the direction of Lana Janjanin on the occasion of the 100th anniversary of his birth ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2025) Ime Miljenka Prohaske jedno je od onih koje vam se od najranijih susreta s našom glazbom ureže u pamćenje. Malo je ljudi koji su u toj mjeri obilježili modernu popularnu, ali i ozbiljnu glazbu na ovim prostorima. Moglo bi se čak reći da su njezina povijest i Prohaskina biografija u većem dijelu 20. stoljeća praktički sinonimi. U tom se preklapanju koje je trajalo desetljećima - od samog kraja 30-ih do njegove smrti 2014. godine - posebno izdvaja linija koju Prohaska dijeli s domaćim jazzom. On ne samo da je pionir hrvatskog i jugoslavenskog jazza, nego je i jedan od njegovih najvažnijih institucionalnih pokretača. Jedan je od utemeljitelja Plesnog orkestra Radija Zagreb, današnjeg Jazz orkestra HRT-a, čiji je šef-dirigent bio više od tri desetljeća. Bio je članom Zagrebačkog jazz kvarteta i kvinteta, a osim s domaćim glazbenicima, ostvario je niz suradnji sa svjetskim velikanima jazza, poput Johna Lewisa i Arta Farmera. Prohaska je uz Boška Petrovića zasigurno naš međunarodno najpriznatiji džezist, i to ponajprije kao dirigent i kompozitor. Primjerice, godine 1967. je na glasovitom festivalu Monterey vodio orkestar Dona Ellisa u izvedbi vlastitih skladbi, dok ga je glasoviti Downbeat uvrštavao među najvažnije jazz dirigente. Njegova "Intima", nastala 1962., smatra se međunarodno najizvođenijom hrvatskom jazz-kompozicijom. Počast Prohaski najbolje je odati glazbom, a upravo to je potkraj ožujka u Koncertnoj dvorani Vatroslava Lisinskog učinio za ovu prigodu utemeljeni Prohaska Big Band odsviravši autorski koncert pod ravnanjem Lane Janjanin u povodu 100. godišnjice njegova rođenja...

programme.title: Oasis, desert guards / Oaze, pustinjske stražarnice
programme.desc: Oasis - (E04, Nature. Film, France, 2020) in the east of Morocco, at the foot of the Atlas Mountain Massif, the Tafilalt Valley hides one of the largest oases in the world. Unfortunately, this series of green islands that feeds the complex irrigation system in the middle of the desert today is threatened by climate change. Oasis of Tafilalta must face heavy challenges such as reducing water reserves, a decline in the quality of agricultural land and rural exodus. Faced with these emergencies, people have launched numerous renovation projects, and Oasis shows incredible resistance that could provide a model in today's world to deal with a climate crisis. R .: Guy Beauche ... / Oasis - (E04, prirod. film, Francuska, 2020) Na istoku Maroka, u podnožju planinskog masiva Atlas, dolina Tafilalt krije jednu od najvećih oaza na svijetu. Nažalost, taj niz zelenih otočića kojeg usred pustinje hrani kompleksni sustav navodnjavanja danas ugrožavaju klimatske promjene. Oaza Tafilalta mora se suočiti s teškim izazovima kao što su smanjenje vodnih rezervi, pad kvalitete poljoprivrednih zemljišta i ruralni egzodus. Suočeni s tim hitnim problemima, ljudi su pokrenuli brojne projekte obnove, a oaza pokazuje nevjerojatnu otpornost koja bi u današnjem svijetu mogla pružiti model za suočavanje s klimatskom krizom. R.: Guy Beauche...

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Mundi Classics - (Concert Film, Croatia, 2021) Samobor Music Autumn established itself as a leading international music festival in northern Croatia. We know why we will go to Samobor: to hear the playing of the best Croatian musicians from home and abroad. All those we have been listening to in various chamber formations at the opening of the 46th of Samobor music for years. They performed together, as many as 16 of them. In a small chamber orchestra, they perform 1. Symphony in G-Duru Gustav Mahler in the Chamber version made by the German classic pianist and conductor Klaus Simon. programme.title: The opening ceremony of the 55th. Varaždin Baroque Evenings / Svečano otvorenje 55. Varaždinskih baroknih večeri
programme.desc: The opening ceremony of the 55th Varaždin Baroque Evenings - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2025) The National Festival of the Varaždin Baroque Evening is the most significant music and stage event of central Croatia, founded in 1971, and today it is one of the most modern festivals of its kind in the world. The Jubilee 55 will be performed by musicians from as many as 17 countries, previous partners, and the festival opens with a renowned Italian ensemble Il Giardino Armonico under the artistic leadership of one of the co-founders of the Giovanni Antonini ensemble and the charismatic mandolinist Avital. Founded in 1985, Il Giardino Armonico is one of the world's leading ensemble specializing in the interpretation of the 17th and 18th and 18th centuries and profiled itself as a reference for the performance of late Baroque and early classicism on historical instruments. Known for her energetic and historically based interpretations, the ensemble has performed at prestigious festivals around the world and collaborated with top musicians, and their albums regularly win the most respected awards in classical music: Grammy, Gramophone Award, Diapason Dor, Choc de Classica, Echo Klassik others. Avital Avital is the first mandolinist nominated for the Grammy Award for classical music and a key personality in modern revitalization of mandolin. His virtuoso and charismatic interpretations lead him to the stages of the world's most prestigious halls and distinguished international festivals, and regularly performs with the leading world orchestras and ensembles. Giovanni Antonini was born in Milan and studied at Civica Scuola di Musica and at the Centers de Musique Ancienne in Geneva. Il Giardino Armonico has been running since 1989 and has been acting as a conductor and soloist on the flute block and a baroque transverse flute (traverso). He is also the first guest-dirigent Kammerorchester Basel. At our biggest and oldest festival of Baroque music, in the broadcast from the Varaždin Cathedral, excellent musicians will be presented with the compositions of A. Ivančić, G. Paisiella, A. Vivaldi and J. S .... / Svečano otvorenje 55. Varaždinskih baroknih večeri - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2025) Nacionalni Festival Varaždinske barokne večeri najznačajnija je glazbeno-scenska priredba središnje Hrvatske, osnovana 1971., a danas je jedan od najeminentnijih festivala te vrste u svijetu. Na jubilarnom 55. izdanju nastupit će glazbenici iz čak 17 zemalja, dosadašnjih zemalja-partnera, a festival otvara renomirani talijanski ansambl Il Giardino Armonico pod umjetničkim vodstvom jednog od suosnivača ansambla Giovannija Antoninija i karizmatični mandolinist Avi Avital. Utemeljen 1985. godine, Il Giardino Armonico ubraja se među vodeće svjetske ansamble specijalizirane za interpretaciju glazbe 17. i 18. stoljeća te se profilirao kao referenca za izvedbu glazbe kasnog barokna i ranog klasicizma na povijesnim instrumentima. Poznat po energičnim, virtuoznim i povijesno utemeljenim interpretacijama, ansambl je nastupao na prestižnim festivalima diljem svijeta i surađivao s vrhunskim glazbenicima, a njihovi albumi redovito osvajaju najuglednije nagrade u klasičnoj glazbi: Grammy, Gramophone Award, Diapason dOr, Choc de Classica, Echo Klassik, Opus Klassik, i druge. Avi Avital prvi je mandolinist nominiran za nagradu Grammy za klasičnu glazbu i ključna osobnost u suvremenoj revitalizaciji mandoline. Njegove virtuozne i karizmatične interpretacije vode ga na pozornice najprestižnijih svjetskih dvorana i uglednih međunarodnih festivala, a redovito nastupa s vodećim svjetskim orkestrima i ansamblima. Giovanni Antonini rođen je u Milanu, a studirao je na Civica Scuola di Musica te na Centre de Musique Ancienne u Ženevi. Il Giardino Armonico vodi od 1989. godine te nastupa kao dirigent i solist na blok flauti te baroknoj poprečnoj flauti (traverso). Također je prvi gost-dirigent Kammerorchestera Basel. Na našem najvećem i najstarijem festivalu barokne glazbe, u prijenosu iz varaždinske katedrale, izvrsni glazbenici predstavit će se skladbama A. Ivančića, G. Paisiella, A. Vivaldija i J. S....

programme.title: File: Submitted Shrine / File: Potopljeno svetište
programme.desc: Philae: Das Versunkene Heiligtum - (Doc. Film, Germany, 2023) In the late 1970s, one of the largest archeological sites in Egypt almost swallowed the river. The whole site is "moved" to the artificial island of File, modeled on the original site. The film made on the occasion of the 40th anniversary of the rescue action, led by UNESCO, will try to show with the help of 3D reconstructions what the ruins looked like before the water partially covered them. Look at the ancient temples in their full splendor. Thanks to the comparative analysis - comparison of images of the remains of buildings from the same period - it is now possible to present that even severely damaged buildings looked at the time of construction, to the smallest details, such as the colors and pigments of the barrel. File, which means "island of the region", became a symbol of resistance, and then the collapse of the ancient Egyptian civilization with the arrival of Christianity when temples were converted to churches. The last printed hieroglyphics are preserved here. R .: Olivier Lema December Ul.: Dan Friedrich (Narrator), Holger Cubelmann (Self - ägyptologist, Österreichische Academie der Wissenschaften, Wien / Self - ägyptologist, Universitat Leipzig), Shaima Magdi (Self) - ägyptologist, Franzosisches the Fur Orientalische Archaologie Institute), Daniel Menet (Self - Ingenieur, Nationalgeographische Institute) ... / Philae: Das versunkene Heiligtum - (dok. film, Njemačka, 2023) Krajem 1970-ih jedno od najvećih arheoloških nalazišta u Egiptu zamalo je progutala rijeka. Cijelo je nalazište "preseljeno" na umjetni otok File napravljen po uzoru na izvorni lokalitet. Film snimljen u povodu 40. godišnjice akcije spašavanja, koju je predvodio UNESCO, pokušat će uz pomoć 3D rekonstrukcije prikazati kako su ruševine izgledale prije nego što ih je djelomično prekrila voda. Pogledajte drevne hramove u njihovom punom sjaju. Zahvaljujući komparativnoj analizi - usporedbi slika ostataka građevina iz istog razdoblja - sada je moguće predočiti kako su čak i teško oštećena zdanja izgledala u vrijeme izgradnje, i to do najsitnijih detalja, kao što su boje i pigmenti bareljefa. File, što znači "otok kraja", postao je simbolom otpora, a potom i propasti drevne egipatske civilizacije s dolaskom kršćanstva kad su hramovi pretvoreni u crkve. Ovdje su sačuvani i posljednji ispisani hijeroglifi. R.: Olivier Lemaître Ul.: Dana Friedrich (Narrator), Holger Kockelmann (Self - Ägyptologe, Österreichische Akademie der Wissenschaften, Wien / Self - Ägyptologe, Universitat Leipzig), Shaima Magdi (Self), Lorenzo Medini (Self - Ägyptologe, Franzosisches Institut fur orientalische Archaologie), Daniel Menet (Self - Ingenieur, Nationalgeographisches Institut)...

programme.desc: Photo in Croatia - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2013) The charismatic oeuvre of Brkan brothers, two true greats of contemporary Croatian photographs, are the foundation of the so -called. Zadar schools of photography. Older brother Ante (1918-2004) in 1951 opens a photographic studio in Zadar. For the whole treasure trove of masterful works, he should not have traveled to unknown and exotic countries, seek sophisticated and aesthetic motives. He creates his works on the threshold of the family home and in the "calet" of his city. The value of these photos, far ahead of his time, was difficult to recognize at the time as a true masterpiece. Only when there were numerous awards at international photographic salons in the world, did we dare to say that the photo could be something completely different, that the topic was irrelevant, and the motive was just an external form for multiple mean layers ... / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2013) Karizmatski opusi braće Brkan, dvojice istinskih velikana suvremene hrvatske fotografije, temelj su tzv. zadarske škole fotografije. Za cijelu riznicu majstorskih djela nije trebao putovati u nepoznate i egzotične zemlje, tražiti sofisticirane i estetizirane motive. Svoja djela on stvara na pragu obiteljskog doma i po "kaletama" svoga grada. Vrijednost tih fotografija, daleko ispred svoga vremena, bilo je tada teško prepoznati kao istinska remek-djela. Tek kada su na međunarodnim fotografskim salonima u svijetu osvojile brojne nagrade, usudili smo se ustvrditi da fotografija može biti i nešto sasvim drugo, da je tema nebitna, a motiv tek vanjska forma za mnogostruke značenjske slojeve...

programme.desc: Sound collector - (E16, feature series, Croatia) a collector of sounds wakes up and finds Mirta down as staring at the carrot cake on the kitchen table. Instead of the cake, she gives her breakfast and goes out in search of sounds. They are connected on the tractor and then a scarecrow in the middle of the cereal field is observed from the place of shooting on the branches of the tree. When there is a scarecrow, she notes that there is no bird singing there. He does his job great. But it doesn't look very happy, it's certainly very lonely. At the house of Mirta, she still stares at the cake, but then her enemy flies appeared and her new goal becomes her catching her, making a mess in the house. In the meantime, a collector of sounds hears a new sound, a bird chirping. There is a little nest in the chest of scarecrows with birds waiting for their parents. The scarecrow, however, is not lonely, and the birds seem happy in their home. Before he leaves, the collector of sounds sets the scarecrow of his mouth into a big smile. The house is in a mess, but the carrot cake is, for a wonderful miracle, intact. He cuts off one piece for a sink, but there is a fly back, and Mirta drives her out to the garden while the collector looks at the porch and eats the cake ... / Skupljač zvukova - (E16, igrana serija, Hrvatska) Skupljač zvukova budi se i zatekne Mirtu dolje kako bulji u tortu od mrkve na kuhinjskom stolu. Umjesto torte daje joj doručak i odlazi van u potragu za zvukovima. Poveze se na traktoru te zatim s mjesta snimanja na granama stabla uočava strašilo nasred žitnog polja. Kad dođe do strašila primjećuje da ondje nema pjeva ptica. Odlično obavlja svoj posao. No ne izgleda baš sretno, sigurno je jako usamljeno. Kod kuće Mirta i dalje bulji u tortu, ali tada se pojavljuje njezina neprijateljica Muha i novi cilj joj postaje uloviti je te pritom stvara nered u kući. U međuvremenu Skupljač zvukova čuje novi zvuk, cvrkutanje ptića. U prsima strašila nalazi se malo gnijezdo s ptićima koji čekaju svoje roditelje. Strašilo ipak nije usamljeno, a i ptići se čine sretni u svom domu. Prije nego što ode, Skupljač zvukova namjesti strašilu usta u veliki osmijeh. Kuća je u neredu, ali torta od mrkve je, za divno čudo, netaknuta. On odreže jedan komad za Mirtu, ali uto se vrati Muha, a Mirta je tjera van u vrt dok Skupljač zvukova gleda s trijema i jede tortu...

programme.title: File: Submitted Shrine / File: Potopljeno svetište
programme.desc: Philae: Das Versunkene Heiligtum - (Doc. Film, Germany, 2023) In the late 1970s, one of the largest archeological sites in Egypt almost swallowed the river. The whole site is "moved" to the artificial island of File, modeled on the original site. The film made on the occasion of the 40th anniversary of the rescue action, led by UNESCO, will try to show with the help of 3D reconstructions what the ruins looked like before the water partially covered them. Look at the ancient temples in their full splendor. Thanks to the comparative analysis - comparison of images of the remains of buildings from the same period - it is now possible to present that even severely damaged buildings looked at the time of construction, to the smallest details, such as the colors and pigments of the barrel. File, which means "island of the region", became a symbol of resistance, and then the collapse of the ancient Egyptian civilization with the arrival of Christianity when temples were converted to churches. The last printed hieroglyphics are preserved here. R .: Olivier Lema December Ul.: Dan Friedrich (Narrator), Holger Cubelmann (Self - ägyptologist, Österreichische Academie der Wissenschaften, Wien / Self - ägyptologist, Universitat Leipzig), Shaima Magdi (Self) - ägyptologist, Franzosisches the Fur Orientalische Archaologie Institute), Daniel Menet (Self - Ingenieur, Nationalgeographische Institute) ... / Philae: Das versunkene Heiligtum - (dok. film, Njemačka, 2023) Krajem 1970-ih jedno od najvećih arheoloških nalazišta u Egiptu zamalo je progutala rijeka. Cijelo je nalazište "preseljeno" na umjetni otok File napravljen po uzoru na izvorni lokalitet. Film snimljen u povodu 40. godišnjice akcije spašavanja, koju je predvodio UNESCO, pokušat će uz pomoć 3D rekonstrukcije prikazati kako su ruševine izgledale prije nego što ih je djelomično prekrila voda. Pogledajte drevne hramove u njihovom punom sjaju. Zahvaljujući komparativnoj analizi - usporedbi slika ostataka građevina iz istog razdoblja - sada je moguće predočiti kako su čak i teško oštećena zdanja izgledala u vrijeme izgradnje, i to do najsitnijih detalja, kao što su boje i pigmenti bareljefa. File, što znači "otok kraja", postao je simbolom otpora, a potom i propasti drevne egipatske civilizacije s dolaskom kršćanstva kad su hramovi pretvoreni u crkve. Ovdje su sačuvani i posljednji ispisani hijeroglifi. R.: Olivier Lemaître Ul.: Dana Friedrich (Narrator), Holger Kockelmann (Self - Ägyptologe, Österreichische Akademie der Wissenschaften, Wien / Self - Ägyptologe, Universitat Leipzig), Shaima Magdi (Self), Lorenzo Medini (Self - Ägyptologe, Franzosisches Institut fur orientalische Archaologie), Daniel Menet (Self - Ingenieur, Nationalgeographisches Institut)...

He also published this scope under the label of the famous Viennese publishing house of the Universal Edition, and from it Mahler's music reads 16 musicians, composed of two violins, viola, cello, counterbas, flute, oboe, two clariners, phagot, two horns, trumpets, piano, harmonica and a set of hits. programme.title: We discover Croatia / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku
programme.desc: We discover Croatia - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2025) there used to be a lot of salt in Croatia in Croatia. Especially in the Middle Ages, Solane in Pag, Nin, Ston, Trogir, Rab, Krk and Cres were known. These cities were enriched thanks to the salt pans. Because of the salt, it fought. In the Roman Empire, the soldiers were paid with salt, in Latin it was called Salarium. And from there the English word for salary salary. Salt was so valuable that they called her white gold. Today, there are three salt socks in Croatia - Pag, Nin and Ston. R.: Zrinka Krešo ... / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) U Hrvatskoj je nekada na Jadranu postojalo dosta solana. U Rimskom Carstvu vojnici su bili plaćeni solju, na latinskom to se zvalo salarium. I od tuda engleska riječ za plaću salary. Sol je bila toliko vrijedna da su ju zvali bijelo zlato. Danas u Hrvatskoj još postoje tri solane - Pag, Nin i Ston. R.: Zrinka Krešo...

programme.title: Genius program / برنامج العباقرة
90 minutes / 90 دقيقة
programme.desc: One of the most important talk shows began to broadcast in 2006 with Moataz Al -Demerdash and Reham Al -Sahli, but in 2011 the journalist Amr Al -Laithi joined the program after Al -Demerdash withdrew from his presentation. The program is concerned with important news and daily events that revolve in the Egyptian and Arab street, as well as monitor the interests, opinions and aspirations of viewers, as well as many guests from politicians, media and economics. / أحد أهم البرامج الحوارية بدأ إذاعته عام 2006 مع معتز الدمرداش وريهام السهلي، ولكن في عام 2011 انضم الإعلامي عمرو الليثي للبرنامج بعد أن انسحب الدمرداش من تقديمه. يهتم البرنامج بالأخبار المهمة والأحداث اليومية التي تدور في الشارع المصري والعربى، كما يرصد أيضاً اهتمامات المشاهدين وآراءهم وتطلعاتهم، كما يستقبل العديد من الضيوف من رجال السياسة والإعلام والاقتصاد.

Morning country / صباح البلد
programme.desc: The program (Sabah Al -Balad) is a comprehensive program in its topics and is shown on (Sada Al -Balad) channel, presented by the media (Dina Ramez). / برنامج (صباح البلد) برنامج شامل في موضوعاته ويعرض على قناة (صدى البلد)، تقدمه الإعلامية (دينا رامز).

programme.title: peacock / الطاووس
programme.desc: Kamal the fleet is a veteran lawyer interested in compensation cases, but the conditions compel him to investigate one of the rape cases that turn his life upside down. / كمال الأسطول محامي مخضرم مهتم بقضايا التعويضات، ولكن الظروف تضطره كي يحقق في إحدى قضايا اﻻغتصاب التي تقلب حياته رأسا على عقب.

programme.title: Raya and Sakina / ريا وسكينة
programme.desc: The story of the life of the two sisters (Raya) and (Sakina), which are one of the most famous criminals of the twentieth century in Egypt. The women spared the beginning of the century and were behind the killing of dozens, and the series shows the circumstances that led to the transformation of the two sisters Raya and Sakina into two criminals, reviewing the developments of their lives and their access to those around them, and the impact of the environment in which the two sisters grew up on their future. / قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما.

programme.title: Covenant / العهد
programme.desc: The events take place inside the Damascene neighborhood in two time periods separated by 15 years, during the period before the liberation of Damascus from the Ottoman occupation, and its hegemony period on the neighborhood, where a strong conflict between the elders and notables of the neighborhood is born to respond and resist it. / تدور الأحداث داخل حارة دمشقية في مرحلتين زمنيتين تفصل بينهما 15 سنة، خلال الفترة التي سبقت تحرير دمشق من الاحتلال العثماني، وفترة هيمنته على الحارة، حيث يولد نزاع قوي بين وجهاء وأعيان الحارة للرد عليه ومقاومته.

programme.title: House of distress / بيت الشدة
programme.desc: A granddaughter and magician's granddaughter called (astronomer) returning to her grandfather's house, in order to take revenge on those who burned the house in the past, in light of a curse chasing her son Saif, which is the domination of the spirit of the grandfather on his body, and she finds herself in the face of the confrontation of the people of Al -Hara led by (Mukhtar) and soon things develop. / حفيدة مشعوذ وساحر تُدعى (فَلك) تعود إلى منزل جدها، لأجل الانتقام مِن مَن حرقوا المنزل قديمًا، في ظل وجود لعنة تطارد ابنها سيف وهي سيطرة روح الجد على جسده، فتجد نفسها في مواجهة تصدي أهل الحارة لها بقيادة (مختار) وسرعان ما تتطور الأمور.

programme.title: Faces / وجوه
programme.desc: The series of faces is divided into two stories: What are you, and Mitafs. The story of a doctor who graduated from the prison was presented to start a journey of searching for her daughter and the journey of facing psychosis. In Metaver, the heroine rejects life in reality and storms the virtual world to take revenge on its enemies. / ينقسم مسلسل وجوه إلى قصتين: وش تالت، وميتافرس. تقدم وش تالت قصة طبيبة تخرج من السجن لتبدأ رحلة بحث عن ابنتها ورحلة مواجهة مرض الذهان. أما في ميتافرس، ترفض البطلة الحياة في الواقع وتقتحم العالم الافتراضي لتنتقم لنفسها من أعدائها.

programme.title: Dalaa girls / دلع بنات
programme.desc: The series revolves around a comic framework about class differences in society through the story of two friends, one of which belongs to the popular class, while the other belongs to the bourgeois class, and this difference between them generates many paradoxes and comic situations. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في إطار كوميدي حول الفوارق الطبقية في المجتمع من خلال قصة صديقتين، تنتمي إحداهما للطبقة الشعبية، بينما تنتمى الأخرى للطبقة البرجوازية، ويولد هذا الاختلاف بينهما العديد من المفارقات والمواقف الكوميدية.

The women spared the beginning of the century and were behind the killing of dozens, and the series shows the circumstances that led to the transformation of the two sisters Raya and Sakina into two criminals, reviewing the developments of their lives and their access to those around them, and the impact of the environment in which the two sisters grew up on their future. / قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما.

programme.title: Covenant / العهد
programme.desc: The events take place inside the Damascene neighborhood in two time periods separated by 15 years, during the period before the liberation of Damascus from the Ottoman occupation, and its hegemony period on the neighborhood, where a strong conflict between the elders and notables of the neighborhood is born to respond and resist it. / تدور الأحداث داخل حارة دمشقية في مرحلتين زمنيتين تفصل بينهما 15 سنة، خلال الفترة التي سبقت تحرير دمشق من الاحتلال العثماني، وفترة هيمنته على الحارة، حيث يولد نزاع قوي بين وجهاء وأعيان الحارة للرد عليه ومقاومته.

programme.title: House of distress / بيت الشدة
programme.desc: A granddaughter and magician's granddaughter called (astronomer) returning to her grandfather's house, in order to take revenge on those who burned the house in the past, in light of a curse chasing her son Saif, which is the domination of the spirit of the grandfather on his body, and she finds herself in the face of the confrontation of the people of Al -Hara led by (Mukhtar) and soon things develop. / حفيدة مشعوذ وساحر تُدعى (فَلك) تعود إلى منزل جدها، لأجل الانتقام مِن مَن حرقوا المنزل قديمًا، في ظل وجود لعنة تطارد ابنها سيف وهي سيطرة روح الجد على جسده، فتجد نفسها في مواجهة تصدي أهل الحارة لها بقيادة (مختار) وسرعان ما تتطور الأمور.

programme.title: Faces / وجوه
programme.desc: The series of faces is divided into two stories: What are you, and Mitafs. The story of a doctor who graduated from the prison was presented to start a journey of searching for her daughter and the journey of facing psychosis. In Metaver, the heroine rejects life in reality and storms the virtual world to take revenge on its enemies. / ينقسم مسلسل وجوه إلى قصتين: وش تالت، وميتافرس. تقدم وش تالت قصة طبيبة تخرج من السجن لتبدأ رحلة بحث عن ابنتها ورحلة مواجهة مرض الذهان. أما في ميتافرس، ترفض البطلة الحياة في الواقع وتقتحم العالم الافتراضي لتنتقم لنفسها من أعدائها.

programme.title: Dalaa girls / دلع بنات
programme.desc: The series revolves around a comic framework about class differences in society through the story of two friends, one of which belongs to the popular class, while the other belongs to the bourgeois class, and this difference between them generates many paradoxes and comic situations. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في إطار كوميدي حول الفوارق الطبقية في المجتمع من خلال قصة صديقتين، تنتمي إحداهما للطبقة الشعبية، بينما تنتمى الأخرى للطبقة البرجوازية، ويولد هذا الاختلاف بينهما العديد من المفارقات والمواقف الكوميدية.

programme.title: peacock / الطاووس
programme.desc: Kamal the fleet is a veteran lawyer interested in compensation cases, but the conditions compel him to investigate one of the rape cases that turn his life upside down. / كمال الأسطول محامي مخضرم مهتم بقضايا التعويضات، ولكن الظروف تضطره كي يحقق في إحدى قضايا اﻻغتصاب التي تقلب حياته رأسا على عقب.

Moon face / وجه القمر
programme.desc: (Ibtisam Al -Bustani) is a television broadcaster, married to the businessman (Karim Abu Al -Ezz), showing her first husband (Mustafa Qura) again, who thought he died in a bombing accident in Lebanon during the civil war, and discovers that he did not die in the accident and that he was a arms dealer and fled after he had a bombing with a large wealth. / (ابتسام البستاني) مذيعة تلفزيونية، متزوجة من رجل الأعمال (كريم أبو العز)، يظهر من جديد زوجها اﻷول (مصطفى قورة) الذي ظنت أنه توفي في حادث تفجير في لبنان أثناء الحرب الأهلية، وتكتشف أنه لم يمت بالحادث وأنه كان تاجر سلاح وهرب بعد اصابته بعملية التفجير مع ثروة كبيرة.

programme.title: a play / مسرحية
Diary and Nice C1 / يوميات ونيس ج1
programme.desc: Winis (Mohamed Sobhi) and his wife, Maysa (Souad Nasr), raising their four children on the good morals and values, and while performing this message, they discover that they disagree with many of the values ​​that they are trying to plant in their children, so they try to correct themselves. / يقوم ونيس (محمد صبحي) وزوجته مايسة (سعاد نصر) على تربية أبناءهما الأربعة على الأخلاق والقيم الصالحة، وأثناء تأديتهم لهذه الرسالة يكتشفان أنهما يخالفان الكثير من القيم التي يحاولنان زرعها في أولادهما، فيحاولان التصحيح من نفسيهما.

programme.title: Power and jokes program / برنامج مواقف وطرائف
The secret of the earth / سر الأرض
programme.desc: The events of the series (which continued to be filmed and displayed for several years) revolve around a group of comic situations, reviewing the importance and preservation of the land, and aims to spread awareness, advice, information about agriculture and its concern, in addition to other agricultural projects (such as animal raising), and to provide this information to the peasant category, with the aim of helping them to complete their important and necessary profession for society. / تدور أحداث المسلسل (والذي استمر تصويره وعرضه لعدة سنوات) حول مجموعة من المواقف الكوميدية، تستعرض أهمية الأرض والحفاظ عليها، ويهدف إلى نشر التوعية والنصائح والمعلومات الخاصة بالزراعة وما يخصها، بالإضافة إلى المشروعات الزراعية الأخرى (مثل تربية الحيوانات)، وتقديم هذه المعلومات لفئة الفلاحين، بهدف إعانتهم على استكمال مهنتهم الهامة، والضرورية للمجتمع.

Word of men / كلام رجالة
programme.desc: The series deals with five stories of five women, including the working woman, the woman of society, the important wife of the man, and the corrupt lawyer, but what they collected is that they have replaced their husbands in managing home and family affairs, to decide to gather every Tuesday a week, discuss the problems of each of them, and try to solve them. / يتناول المسلسل خمس قصص لخمس نساء، منهن المرأة العاملة، وسيدة المجتمع، وزوجة الرجل المهم، وحرم المحامي الفاسد، ولكن ما جمعهن هو أنهن حللن محل أزواجهن في إدارة شئون البيت والأسرة، ليقررن التجمع كل يوم ثلاثاء في الأسبوع، ومناقشة مشاكل كل واحدة منهن، ومحاولة حلها.

programme.title: In the blink of an eye / في غمضة عين
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around (Fatima) and (Nabila), two friends, who were raised together with one of the orphans, until they worked two supervisors in the same shelter, suffering from the cruelty of life in the shelter, until Nabila discovers that she has a wealthy uncle and she goes to see him, and on the way an accident occurs and her friend believes that she died, and events escalate. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول (فاطمة) و(نبيلة) وهما صديقتان، تربيتا معاَ بأحد ملاجيء الأيتام، حتى عملتا مشرفتين في الملجأ نفسه، تعانيان من قسوة الحياة في الملجأ، حتى تكتشف نبيلة أن لها عم ثري فتذهب لرؤيته، وفي الطريق تقع حادثة وتعتقد صديقتها أنها ماتت، وتتصاعد الأحداث.

programme.title: flash / فلاش
programme.desc: An artistic program, which offers the latest news of artists and what relates to their works in cinema, theater and television drama. There is also a paragraph for phone interventions with the stars to make statements or discuss an artistic issue. / برنامج فني، يقدم آخر أخبار الفنانين وما يتعلق بأعمالهم في السينما والمسرح والدراما التليفزيونية، كما توجد فقرة للمداخلات الهاتفية مع النجوم للإدلاء بتصريحات أو مناقشة قضية فنية.

programme.title: Asmahan / أسمهان
programme.desc: The work deals with the life story of the late singer Asmahan, from her birth until her transfer from Beirut to Cairo to work as a singer and actress, to shine her name next to her brother Farid Al -Atrash, and the series touches on her relationship with some of the artists who lived with her until her mysterious death. / يتناول العمل قصة حياة المطربة الراحلة أسمهان، منذ ميلادها حتى إنتقالها من بيروت إلى القاهرة للعمل كمطربة وممثلة، ليلمع اسمها بجوار شقيقها فريد الأطرش، ويتطرق المسلسل إلى علاقتها ببعض الفنانين الذين عاصروها وحتى حادث وفاتها الغامض.

programme.title: Delivery groom / عريس دليفري
programme.desc: A simple young man dies his parents without leaving any inheritance for him, and his condition is bad and admires the girl of the daughter of an employee with his father. At the same time, he gets to know the daughter of a businesswoman who owns a hotel in which that young man works, so the mother tries to do what he can to remove her daughter. / شاب بسيط يتوفى والديه دون أن يتركا له اي ميراث فتسوء حالته ويعجب بفتاة ابنة احد الموظفين لدى والده وف الوقت ذاته يتعرف على ابنة سيدة أعمال تمتلك فندقًا يعمل فيه ذلك الشاب فتحاول اﻷم بذل ما في وسعها ﻹبعاده عن ابنتها.

programme.title: Disobedience c 1 / العصيان ج1
programme.desc: Social drama, which discusses the human relations interfering between members of the same family, especially if they are exposed to the temptation of money and does it spoil the souls of human beings to the degree that makes the son covet the money of his father and asks for stone on him under pressure and his wife is urgent. / دراما إجتماعية، تناقش العلاقات الإنسانية المتداخلة بين أفراد الأسرة الواحدة وخاصة إذا ما تعرضوا لإغراء المال وهل يفسد نفوس البشر للدرجة التى تجعل الإبن يطمع فى مال أبيه ويطلب الحجر عليه تحت ضغط والحاح زوجته.
